source_priority: novel through covered manuscript; film visual locations as reference
prompts: Use case: ui-mockup / stylized-concept. Create a polished wide 16:9 gameplay visual concept for an open-world RPG adapted from Die Chroniken von Selantis. This is an art and camera proposal, not a running game screenshot. Protagonist LIA: slim human heroine, long auburn-blonde curls gathered behind her head with a hairband, WHITE gathered-neck long-sleeve blouse, long BROWN skirt, light lace-up leather shoes, LONG GREEN RAIN CLOAK. Modest leather provisions bag and sheathed small family dagger. Human ears, no armor, no visible magic. Eye color unspecified. Source hierarchy: novel appearance overrides film costumes. Setting inspired by reviewed film frames: quiet overcast deciduous woodland clearing, ivy-covered modest red/grey sandstone ruin, rural meadow. Three readable traversable branching paths connect clearing to deeper woods, meadow and ruins. Natural rural scale, muted woodland greens, earth browns, warm red stone, continuous accessible terrain. Show protagonist full body with visibly white blouse and brown skirt, cloak open enough to identify these. Restrained clean German RPG HUD with exact readable labels: upper left 'LIA', 'STUFE 1', short health and XP bars; upper right 'Wald erkunden'; small lower-center action slots 'Interagieren', 'Ausweichen', 'Fokus'; lower right 'Karte', 'Journal', 'Fertigkeiten'. Keep HUD discreet and paths visible. No invented NPCs, enemies, giant castles, glowing weapons, pointed ears, runes, particles, cinematic title lettering or watermarks. Direction A: HAND-PAINTED ISOMETRIC 2.5D OPEN WORLD. Elevated oblique isometric gameplay camera, Lia small but legible amid a richly crafted painterly woodland, textured brushwork, coherent layered depth, clear silhouette and readable world paths. Beautiful restrained atmospheric painting with practical navigable space. Do not use an isolated diorama platform or cinematic portrait.
